sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins before last time out's draw, so they will be heavy favourites against bottom-placed Alsager Town, who have won just once all season and are on a run of five consecutive defeats.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see the gap to leaders Sandbach shift depending on results, with Stafford coming off a recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, third and unbeaten in their last five, host Eccleshall in a match between strong performers—Eccleshall sit fifth but have lost their last outing. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, on a win) face a struggling Wednesfield Community side at home. Bilston Town (sixth, on a two-game winning streak) visit struggling Foley Meir. Shawbury United are in deep trouble with five straight defeats and host Barnton, who have steadied recently with a win. Market Drayton Town, inconsistent this season, take on New Mills, themselves winless in their last two. Brereton Social host bottom-dweller Widnes Town in what should be an easier fixture for the home side. Crewe, second-bottom, attempt to recover against Allscott Heath, who have won their last outing. Cheadle Heath Nomads, second-bottom, travel to Telford Town in a basement battle between two sides struggling for points.
